Generate.title: Generate your avatar
Generate.subtitle: Bring your own API key. Nothing is stored.
Generate.privacyNote: Your image and API key are only used for this generation request. Simi Avatar does not store your API key or images.

states.idle: Configure the form and click Generate.

Source.label: Avatar source
Source.textDescription: Describe an avatar — no photo needed.
Source.photoDescription: Upload a photo and restyle it.

Mode.label: Mode
Mode.textDescription: Pick a style, add a short description, and generate — no photo needed.
Mode.couple-textDescription: Describe a couple and generate a style-matched pair — no photos needed.
Mode.themedDescription: Generate from a theme and prompt — no photo needed.
Mode.singleDescription: Restyle your own photo into an avatar.
Mode.coupleDescription: Generate a style-consistent pair for two people.

Provider.label: Provider
Provider.regionHint: MiniMax Global and China use separate keys and endpoints.

Upload.label: Upload image
Upload.hint: JPG, PNG or WEBP. Up to 10MB, at least 256×256. A clear front-facing portrait works best.
Upload.softHintSmall: This photo is a bit small. A larger head-and-shoulders crop (about 512×512 or more) usually preserves likeness better.
Upload.softHintAspect: This photo is quite wide or tall. A closer square head-and-shoulders crop usually works better for avatars.
Upload.softHintDark: This photo looks underexposed. A brighter, even-lit face usually preserves likeness much better under style restyle.
Upload.softHintBright: This photo looks very bright or blown out. Even lighting with visible facial detail usually works better.

Reference.title: Reference photos
Reference.hint: A clear front photo is required. Extra angles help likeness only when the provider supports multi-reference.
Reference.unsupported: {provider} currently accepts one reference photo. Multi-angle slots unlock only after this provider is verified for multi-reference identity.
Reference.frontOnlyHelp: Use a sharp, well-lit front-facing head-and-shoulders crop for the best likeness today.
Reference.sameFrameUnsupported: Same-frame photo couples need a verified multi-image composite path. {provider} still uses style-matched A/B generation (two calls).

quality.faceVisible: Face fully visible — avoid sunglasses, masks, or hats covering eyes and hairline
quality.evenLight: Even, adequate lighting — dark or harshly shaded faces lose likeness after restyle
quality.headshotCrop: Head-and-shoulders crop with the face filling most of the frame
quality.onePerson: One person only — extra faces in the frame confuse single-avatar identity
quality.preferFront: Prefer a front or slight three-quarter view over a full side profile

roleHelp.expression: helps a natural smile or neutral look

History.label: Recent setups
History.localOnly: Saved only in this browser — never uploaded.
History.clearOnKeyClear: Also clear your local generation history?

Form.promptPlaceholder: e.g. blue background, soft lighting, friendly smile
Form.descriptionPlaceholder: e.g. a friendly portrait with a warm smile, soft studio lighting
Form.creativeSetupHint: Pick the source, mode, style, and description before connecting a provider.
Form.providerSetupHint: Choose where to generate, then paste your own key only when you are ready.
Form.verifyHint: Complete the quick challenge so we know you are human. It protects the shared demo and is not stored.
Form.finishRequired: Finish the required fields to generate.
Form.pairedConsistencyHint: Share palette, background, lighting and composition across both avatars.
Form.sameFrame: Same frame (both partners in one image)
Form.compiledPromptHint: The exact prompt sent to {provider} for your current setup. Your API key is never part of it.

Suggestions.label: Need ideas? Try a starter prompt:

Refinement.label: Refine
Refinement.conversationNote: The provider continues from the selected result and its active-session context.
Refinement.imageEditNote: The selected result is sent back for this edit and is not persisted.
Refinement.regenerateNote: This is a new generation from the accumulated intent. The displayed result is not sent back, so identity or composition may change.
Refinement.costNote: Each refinement runs another provider generation and uses your API key's quota.
Refinement.reviewBeforeCall: Review the change and preserve plan below before spending another provider call.

EditPlan.title: Edit plan
EditPlan.hint: Edit what should change and what must stay the same. Nothing is sent until you confirm.
EditPlan.costNote: Confirming runs one more provider call with your API key.
EditPlan.stale: This plan no longer matches the selected result. Cancel and draft a new plan from the current candidate.

Candidates.title: Session candidates
Candidates.hint: Switch between results from this page session. Candidates are not saved after reload.

Agent.briefLabel: Describe your avatar in a sentence
Agent.briefPlaceholder: e.g. LinkedIn headshot, friendly, studio background
Agent.briefHint: We map your words to the settings below — no AI call, nothing leaves your browser. Adjust anything after.
Agent.refinePlaceholder: e.g. more like me, make it work for LinkedIn

risk.likeness-without-photo: High likeness needs a photo; text modes can't match a real face.
risk.creativity-vs-professional: High creativity can undercut a clean professional look.
risk.transparent-approximate: Providers approximate cutout backgrounds; true transparency isn't guaranteed.
risk.pair-consistency: Two separate calls — the pair may not match perfectly.
risk.same-frame-blend: Both partners share one frame; features can blend.
risk.stylized-likeness-drift: High likeness with anime, comic, or other stylized looks can age-shift or enlarge eyes. Prefer a professional style, or lower likeness.
risk.single-subject-reference: Use one clear front-facing person only. Extra faces or full-side profiles make identity matching unreliable.
risk.full-body-face-size: Full-body framing shrinks the face. Prefer headshot or half-body when likeness matters.

Result.partialPair: Only part of the pair came back. The paired request still used your provider quota.
Result.empty: Your generated avatar will appear here.
Result.emptyHint: Start with text for the fastest path, or switch to photo when likeness matters.
Result.generatingHint: Provider response time varies by model and image size.
Result.generatingKeep: Generating a new version. The last result stays visible until it returns.
Result.emptySuccess: The provider returned no images. Please try again.
Result.editFailedPreserved: The edit failed, so the previous result is still shown.

Errors.INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS: Your provider account is out of credits or quota.
Errors.INVALID_IMAGE: The uploaded image could not be read.
Errors.IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: The image is too large. Please use a smaller file.
Errors.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Unsupported file type. Use JPG, PNG or WEBP.
Errors.INVALID_MODE_INPUT: The inputs do not match the selected mode.
Errors.INVALID_REGION: The key does not match the selected MiniMax region.
Errors.PROVIDER_TIMEOUT: The provider took too long to respond. Please try again.
Errors.CONTENT_REJECTED: The request was blocked by the provider's content policy.
Errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.
Errors.UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: Unsupported request type. Please submit the form again.
Errors.FORBIDDEN: This request was blocked. Please reload the page and try again.

Errors.MISSING_API_KEY: Please enter your API key first.

About.title: About Simi Avatar
About.intro: Simi Avatar is an open-source, no-signup, BYOK AI avatar generator. You bring your own provider API key and generate avatars from a text description or from your own photo.
About.modelsBody: OpenAI gpt-image-2, MiniMax image-01 (Global and China), fal.ai FLUX.1 [dev], and xAI grok-imagine-image-quality.
About.securityBody: Your API key and images pass through the server only in memory for a single request, and are never stored or logged.
About.deployBody: Self-host anywhere that runs Next.js. The reference deployment target is Cloudflare Workers.

Legal.title: Legal
Legal.disclaimerBody: Simi Avatar is provided as-is, without warranty. You are responsible for your own API key usage and any content you generate.
Legal.termsBody: Do not use Simi Avatar to generate illegal, sexual, hateful content, or to deceptively impersonate real people.
Legal.privacyBody: Simi Avatar stores no data. Your API key lives only in your browser session; images and keys are used only for a single generation request and are never persisted or logged.
